title: Shifted Anticoncentration for Real Gram Hafnians and Symmetric Gaussian Hafnians
summary: We prove a uniform shifted anticoncentration theorem for the hafnian of a real Gaussian Gram matrix under an explicit condition on the row dimension. After normalization by its root mean square, the law has a bounded continuous density, maximal at zero, and every interval has probability bounded by an explicit coefficient times its radius. Under suitable growth conditions on the row dimension, this coefficient grows at most polynomially in the hafnian order, meaning half the dimension of the Gram matrix.
